signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Start your free trial — no credit card required
signup.legal: By creating an account you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we’ll send you a reset link.

resetPassword.title: Set new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a strong password for your account.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: Enter a new password — at least 8 characters.

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.subtitle: Upload a square image — PNG or JPG, under 2 MB.

onboarding.title: Tell us about your business
onboarding.subtitle: We’ll set up your chart of accounts automatically based on your business type.

website.label: Company website
website.hint: We’ll use it to tailor your AI marketing and content.

category.label: What does your business do?
category.placeholder: Pick one or type your own…

location.label: Where are you based?
location.hint: Lets your AI write local-market content for your area.

description.label: Describe your business
description.placeholder: What you offer, who you serve, and what makes you different — a couple of sentences is plenty.
description.hint: The more you share, the better your AI-generated posts and topics.

sole_prop.label: Sole Proprietor
sole_prop.description: You run the business yourself with no formal structure.

llc.label: LLC
llc.description: Limited liability company — the most common small business choice.

s_corp.label: S Corporation
s_corp.description: Pass-through taxation with corporate liability protection.

c_corp.label: C Corporation
c_corp.description: Separate legal entity — common for funded startups.

partnership.label: Partnership
partnership.description: Two or more owners sharing profits and liability.

nonprofit.label: Non-profit
nonprofit.description: 501(c) or other tax-exempt organization funded by donations and grants.

onboarding.footnote: Your chart of accounts will be pre-populated — you can customize it later.

accepted.title: Estimate accepted!
accepted.body: We’ll be in touch shortly to get started.

declined.title: Estimate declined
declined.body: Thank you for letting us know. Feel free to reach out with any questions.
